title: Phase 136 — DORK ConversationLedger Verify Hardening + Enrichment Bridge Hardening

changes.change: ConversationLedger canonical hash payload parity: append() and verify() now both key on {role, content_digest, timestamp, prev_hash}; verify() recomputes expected entry_hash from chain-derived prev_hash, returns seq-indexed entry_hash mismatch failure reason

Added ConversationLedger.restore_entry() for authoritative chain hydration: enforces role validation, seq continuity, prev-hash continuity, canonical entry-hash recomputation before append-only insertion
Fleet startup hydration uses restore_entry() semantics from persistence entries instead of calling append() with pre-digested content — eliminates double-hashing on restart

Tamper-detection tests added: prove verify() failure for content_digest, timestamp, entry_hash, and prev_hash chain mutation; restore path coverage for exact hash preservation and fail-closed prev-hash continuity
Restart hydration regression: persisted entries restored byte-for-byte in memory with seq/hash continuity enforcement

Patched runtime-instance sendMessage via initDorkRuntime so enrichment metadata (intent, kbHit, fanOutCount) is returned for both direct runtime usage and the global sendMessage proxy path; added internal runtime event bridge (EventTarget) and emitEvent exposure to emit enrichment events without relying on undefined _eventTarget
Added sendThroughDorkRuntime(msg, options) integration bridge to route calls through dorkRuntime.sendMessage when needed by UI contract checks
Static contract checks asserting runtime-instance patching, metadata return shape, and whaledic runtime bridge wiring
